plan: An aggressive jungler who charges at his target, knocks it up and wins duels in the early game.
aSurveiller: His E (Audacious Charge). This leap is what lets him reach you; then the 3rd attack of his Q knocks you up.
contrer: Keep an escape spell for after his charge (E): he has no other way to catch you.
Avoid duels early: he is very strong early, call your allies.
After his R he ignores ranged damage for a while: don't shoot him from afar, back off and wait.
forces: Very strong early and in duels.
His charge (E) lets him engage from afar.
Heals regularly thanks to his passive.
faiblesses: Only one real gap closer: his E.
Loses power if the game goes long.
Easy to slow and kite once his charge is used.

sorts.P: Every 3 attacks, he deals bonus damage and heals.
sorts.Q: His next 3 attacks hurt more; the 3rd knocks up.
sorts.W: Spear thrust that slows and marks the enemies hit.
sorts.E: Charges an enemy and slows them; longer range on a marked target.
sorts.R: Knocks back nearby enemies and blocks damage from afar.

momentFort: Very dangerous from the first levels, especially up to the mid game.
